title: Article With Sidebar Toggle
content:
The first paragraph introduces the topic with enough text to score as the main content of the page so that the body extractor will pick this section.

A second paragraph keeps the prose flowing and ensures the article has more than one block of substantive text to anchor the content score.

![Storage migration: SD to NVMe](https://sidebar-toggle-checkbox/media/orangepi-storage-migration.svg)

Storage migration: SD to NVMe

A closing paragraph after the diagram explains what the figure shows and gives the article a tidy conclusion that should survive extraction.
